title: Studio, with more room to breathe
question: The same spacious layout in three palettes. Left navigation, search, breadcrumbs and shorter AI guidance are shared. Choose a palette or tell me what to adjust. These are fictional design studies.

options.label: Forest & Chalk
options.thesis: Grounded, clear and easy on the eyes.
options.viewport: Studio proportions with search, breadcrumbs, one activity and concise contextual help.
options.risk: The dark sidebar remains a strong visual anchor.

options.label: Plum & Porcelain
options.thesis: Warm character with a distinctive, deeper accent.
options.viewport: Studio proportions with search, breadcrumbs, one activity and concise contextual help.
options.risk: The richer hue has more personality; judge whether it feels right every day.

options.label: Stone & Clay
options.thesis: A lighter sidebar with color reserved for actions.
options.viewport: Studio proportions with search, breadcrumbs, one activity and concise contextual help.
options.risk: Quieter branding and less contrast between navigation and content.
